nodes.name: 06:00 Manila
nodes.notes: Set the WORKFLOW timezone to Asia/Manila (workflow Settings > Timezone). n8n cron runs in the workflow's timezone; the default is UTC, which would deliver this at 14:00 Manila.

nodes.name: Build and send the brief
nodes.notes: Pick the 'George brief token' Header Auth credential in this node. The backend builds AND renders the brief — n8n is deliberately a dumb pipe, because 'notices always surface' is a product guarantee and templating the message here would move it into something anyone can edit.

nodes.name: Every message delivered?
nodes.notes: ok is false when ANY message to ANY chat failed. A brief split into three that lost the middle one reads as complete, with items silently missing.

parameters.text: ={{ 'The morning brief did not run: ' + JSON.stringify($json).slice(0, 500) }}

nodes.name: Say that it failed
nodes.notes: THE POINT OF THIS BRANCH: a job that fails silently is indistinguishable from a quiet morning. Nobody notices an absent brief; they notice one that says it broke. Pick your Telegram credential here.
